title: 第十五章 宗内大比

content_zh:
叶希文，身影一晃，跟了上去。
“可恶啊，怎么会这样，这些畜生！”好不容易张家参与的几个人逃脱了铁背银猿群的追杀，刀疤脸中年男子身上满是血迹，都是和铁背银猿王的搏斗的时候留下来的，如果不是果断的撤走，只怕他们要全军覆没。
“回去之后，让家主调集高手，将这些畜生一网打尽，不然难消心头之恨啊！”一个张家的武者咬牙切齿的说道。
“还有那个凶手，杀了我们两位少主，实在是太可恶了，这次的事情也有蹊跷，那些铁背银猿怎么会好死不死的挡在我们的去路上！”又一个武者不甘心的说道，来的时候浩浩荡荡几十人，但是逃走的时候只剩下了五六人还活着了。
“杀死，统统都要杀死，碎尸万段！”刀疤脸中年男子咬牙切齿的说道。
“你们只怕没有机会了！”只听一声清朗的声音传了出来。
张家的众人抬头一看，却见一个约莫着十七八岁的少年目光清冷的看着他们。
正是叶希文！
“是你，就是你杀害了我们的少主！”存活下来的五个人中也有之前那一队人马，认识叶希文。“我们张家不会放过你的！”
“你们以后都没机会回去了！”叶希文冷笑着说道。
“小子你找死！”那个刀疤脸中年男子大喝一声，抽出长刀，朝叶希文劈去，刀光闪烁，刀气逼人。
虽然已经身受重伤，但是后天七重的武者到底是后天七重的武者，就算是身受重伤，等闲的后天六重的武者在这一刀下也绝难逃命。
不过可惜，叶希文不是什么等闲的后天六重的高手，现在就算是那个刀疤脸中年男子巅峰状态他都能斗上一斗，更别说现在重伤状态了。
“锵！”
叶希文瞬间抽出长刀，逼人的寒芒要遮蔽人的眼睛，叶希文一刀劈出《新月斩》，犀利的刀气劈裂开了空气，瞬间斩了下去。
“轰！”
那个刀疤脸中年男子的刀气被叶希文的月牙刀气给生生击溃，一路直冲而下，势若闪电，竟是将奔雷手的精髓都加入了进来，那个刀疤脸中年男子根本就来不及逃脱。
那个刀疤脸中年男子只来得及惊悚的看着叶希文喊出：“怎么可能，是新。。。”
刀光闪现，那个刀疤脸中年男子直接被从中间劈成两半。
鲜血喷洒而出！

显然这个刀疤脸中年男子已经认出了这一招，但是来不及说出口。
“什么，怎么可能，执事居然被杀了！”
“执事不是有后天七重的实力么？几乎不比一些核心弟子要差了，怎么可能会被一刀斩杀！”
“好可怕的刀法！”
见那个刀疤脸中年男子被一刀斩杀，顿时张家仅剩的几个人士气大溃，本来他们就是刚刚溃败下来的，现在连他们中最为厉害的刀疤脸中年男子都被叶希文一刀斩杀，他们不过是后天四重五重罢了，他们再也提不起抵抗的心情了。
剩下的四人大喊一声，四散开逃，不过叶希文是绝对不会让他们逃走的，张家是青峰山上的两大势力之一，这些人都见过了自己了，如果让他们逃掉，自己恐怕真的会麻烦不断，甚至会面临张家的雷霆报复。
“锵！”叶希文提纵全身的功力，一刀将劈出。
刀气纵横，快如闪电，在一瞬间就劈出了六刀，一个逃跑的张家武者就已经身首分离！
叶希文几乎没有任何的停滞，长刀在手，横扫而出，速度依然奇快无比，带着一丝丝的雷暴声，劈入了又一个武者的身上。
随着两个武者被叶希文斩杀，剩下的两个武者也没能逃脱，最后被叶希文杀死。
中级武技的威力无穷，虽然奔雷手推演到完全之后，完全不下于一些中级武技，但是就杀人的效率来说，叶希文也不得不承认还是新月斩更强一些。
斩杀了最后张家的残余之后，叶希文算是松了一口气，不用再面临张家的追杀了，之后就算张家想继续追究，也要能找的到人才行啊，也得知道是谁才行啊！
暂时摆脱了张家的纠缠，叶希文也没有要回去的想法，他还要在这里继续磨练半个月，因为半个月之后就是一年一度的宗内大比的时候了。
宗内大比是宗内三年一度的盛大活动，不过参加的只有外门弟子和内门弟子两个，也分成外门弟子和内门弟子两个部分，外门弟子前十名可以晋升内门弟子，但是内门弟子中大比的前五名才能晋升核心弟子。

content_en:
Ye Xiwen's figure flashed and followed him.
"Damn it, how could this happen, these beasts!" Several members of the Zhang family managed to escape the pursuit of the Iron-backed Silver Ape group. The middle-aged man with a scar face was covered in blood, which was left from the fight with the Iron-backed Silver Ape King. If they had not retreated decisively, I am afraid they would have been annihilated.
"After we go back, let the head of the family mobilize experts to kill all these beasts, otherwise it will be hard to get rid of the hatred in his heart!" A warrior from the Zhang family said through gritted teeth.
"And that murderer, who killed our two young masters is really abominable. What happened this time is also strange. How could those iron-backed silver apes block our way so hard!" Another warrior said unwillingly. There were dozens of them when they came, but when they escaped, only five or six of them were still alive.
"Kill, kill them all, and cut them into pieces!" the scar-faced middle-aged man said through gritted teeth.
"You're afraid you won't have a chance!" A clear voice came out.
Everyone in the Zhang family looked up and saw a young man about seventeen or eighteen years old looking at them coldly.
It was Ye Xiwen!
"It was you, you killed our young master!" Among the five people who survived, there were also people from the previous team who knew Ye Xiwen. "Our Zhang family will not let you go!"
"You will never have the chance to go back!" Ye Xiwen said with a sneer.
"Boy, you are looking for death!" The middle-aged man with a scarred face shouted loudly, drew out his long knife, and slashed at Ye Xiwen. The light of the knife flashed and the sword's energy was threatening.
Although he has been seriously injured, a warrior at the seventh level of the acquired world is still a warrior at the seventh level of the acquired world. Even if he is seriously injured, an ordinary sixth level warrior will never be able to escape from this sword.
But it's a pity that Ye Xiwen is not an ordinary sixth-level master. He can fight even that scar-faced middle-aged man in his peak state, let alone his current serious injury.
"Qiang!"
Ye Xiwen drew out his long sword in an instant. The cold light threatened to cover people's eyes. Ye Xiwen slashed out the "New Moon Slash" with one strike. The sharp sword energy split the air and slashed down instantly.
"Boom!"
The sword energy of the scar-faced middle-aged man was completely defeated by Ye Xiwen's crescent sword energy, and he rushed straight down with lightning speed, actually adding the essence of the Thunder Hand. The scar-faced middle-aged man had no time to escape.
The scar-faced middle-aged man only had time to look at Ye Xiwen in horror and shout: "How is that possible? It's Xin..."
The sword flashed, and the middle-aged man with the scarred face was directly split in half from the middle.
Blood spurts out!
Apparently the scar-faced middle-aged man had recognized this move, but had no time to say it.
"What, how is it possible? The deacon was actually killed!"
"Doesn't the deacon have the seventh level of acquired strength? He is almost as good as some core disciples. How could he be killed with a single sword!"
"What a terrible swordsmanship!"
Seeing that the scar-faced middle-aged man was killed with a single blow, the few remaining members of the Zhang family were immediately demoralized. They had just been defeated, and now even the most powerful scar-faced middle-aged man among them had been killed by Ye Xiwen with a single blow. They were only the fourth and fifth levels acquired, and they could no longer resist.
The remaining four people shouted and fled, but Ye Xiwen would never let them escape. The Zhang family was one of the two major forces on Qingfeng Mountain. These people had all seen him. If he let them escape, he might really be in trouble, and even face thunderous revenge from the Zhang family.
"Qiang!" Ye Xiwen used all his strength to strike out with a single blow.
The sword energy was vertical and horizontal, as fast as lightning, and six knives were struck in an instant, and the body and head of a fleeing Zhang family warrior had been separated!
Ye Xiwen barely paused at all, with the long knife in his hand, he swept out, the speed was still extremely fast, with a trace of thunderstorm sound, it struck into the body of another warrior.
As the two warriors were beheaded by Ye Xiwen, the remaining two warriors could not escape and were finally killed by Ye Xiwen.
The power of intermediate martial arts is infinite. Although the Thunderbolt Hand is no less powerful than some intermediate martial arts after it is fully deduced, in terms of killing efficiency, Ye Xiwen has to admit that Crescent Slash is still stronger.
After killing the last remnant of the Zhang family, Ye Xiwen breathed a sigh of relief. He no longer had to face the pursuit of the Zhang family. Even if the Zhang family wanted to continue pursuing the case, they would have to find someone and know who it was!
Temporarily freed from the entanglement of the Zhang family, Ye Xiwen had no intention of going back. He would continue to practice here for half a month, because in half a month it would be time for the annual sect competition.
The Grand Competition within the sect is a grand event held every three years within the sect, but only two disciples, the outer disciples and the inner disciples, participate. It is also divided into two parts: outer disciples and inner disciples. The top ten outer disciples can be promoted to inner disciples, but only the top five inner disciples in the competition can be promoted to core disciples.
